purpose: Window rules through core: a run starts (pointer captured), then resizes across the four shapes, a focus loss (the pointer must be released and the run paused at once), focus back (still paused; pointer stays free until the player resumes), and a fullscreen toggle on and off. Zero engine errors; no Super-key bindings. Harness-driven resize under GNOME; the same steps under niri and Umbriel use the -niri/-umbriel presets.
